  • There is no retroactivity. It was a concern, but it didn't happen; what it was going to do is strip people of citizenship that was obtained illegally if proof of such act is found, but that was scrapped. The actual rule simply states that the illegal immigrants that got in the country since 1929 and onwards, are still considered illegal.
  • The law was enacted and therefore made public on 23 sept 2013, and people could apply as soon as 02 jun 2014, until 17 of june 2015. They had more than one and half year to prepare their application.
